entities.summary: The Bukui Mosque is a mosque in Qiqihar, in the Heilongjiang province of China. It is located in Mosque Road off Bukui Street. It was built during the Qing dynasty, and was listed as a Chinese major cultural heritage site in 2006. It is the largest and oldest mosque in Heilongjiang province.
